VENDOR CONSOLIDATION ANALYSIS - Q4 2024
Prepared by: Procurement Team
Date: November 8, 2024

CURRENT STATE
We currently contract with 5 separate vendors for cloud infrastructure services:

1. CloudPeak Systems
   - Annual spend: $2,340,000
   - Contract expires: March 15, 2025
   - Services: compute, storage, networking
   - Uptime SLA: 99.95%
   - Actual uptime (last 12 months): 99.92%
   - Support response time: 4 hours (critical), 24 hours (standard)

2. DataNest Corp
   - Annual spend: $890,000
   - Contract expires: June 30, 2025
   - Services: database hosting, analytics pipeline
   - Uptime SLA: 99.9%
   - Actual uptime: 99.87%
   - Support response time: 2 hours (critical), 8 hours (standard)

3. VaporLogic Inc
   - Annual spend: $1,120,000
   - Contract expires: January 31, 2025
   - Services: serverless compute, API gateway
   - Uptime SLA: 99.99%
   - Actual uptime: 99.94%
   - Support response time: 1 hour (critical), 4 hours (standard)

4. IronCloud Services
   - Annual spend: $560,000
   - Contract expires: September 30, 2025
   - Services: disaster recovery, backup
   - Uptime SLA: 99.9%
   - Actual uptime: 99.96%
   - Support response time: 6 hours (critical), 48 hours (standard)

5. NimbusWorks
   - Annual spend: $430,000
   - Contract expires: December 31, 2024
   - Services: CDN, edge computing
   - Uptime SLA: 99.99%
   - Actual uptime: 99.98%
   - Support response time: 30 min (critical), 2 hours (standard)

TOTAL CURRENT ANNUAL SPEND: $5,340,000

PROPOSED CONSOLIDATION
We recommend consolidating to two vendors:

Vendor A: CloudPeak Systems (retain and expand)
- Would absorb DataNest's database and analytics workloads
- Would absorb IronCloud's DR/backup services
- Proposed annual contract: $3,100,000 (includes volume discount)
- New SLA: 99.95% uptime, 1-hour critical support response

Vendor B: NimbusWorks (retain and expand)
- Would absorb VaporLogic's serverless and API gateway workloads
- Proposed annual contract: $1,400,000 (includes migration discount year 1)
- New SLA: 99.99% uptime, 30-min critical support response

TOTAL PROPOSED ANNUAL SPEND: $4,500,000

PROJECTED SAVINGS
- Year 1: $340,000 (after migration costs of $500,000)
- Year 2: $840,000
- Year 3: $840,000
- 3-year net savings: $2,020,000

MIGRATION COSTS
- DataNest to CloudPeak: $180,000 (database migration, 6 weeks)
- IronCloud to CloudPeak: $90,000 (DR reconfiguration, 3 weeks)
- VaporLogic to NimbusWorks: $230,000 (serverless rewrite, 8 weeks)
- Total migration cost: $500,000
- Migration window: Q1-Q2 2025

RISKS
1. DataNest database migration carries risk of data loss or corruption. Mitigation: parallel run for 30 days.
2. VaporLogic serverless functions may require significant rewrite for NimbusWorks platform. Mitigation: proof of concept on 3 critical functions first.
3. Single-vendor dependency increases for compute (CloudPeak would handle 65% of workload). Mitigation: multi-region deployment and contractual exit clause.
4. IronCloud DR setup is custom; re-creating on CloudPeak may have gaps initially. Mitigation: staged cutover with full DR test before IronCloud contract ends.
5. Team capacity: current infra team is 4 people, migration would require 60% of their time for 14 weeks. Mitigation: contractor support budgeted at $85,000.

OPEN QUESTIONS
- Whether to negotiate a longer contract term with CloudPeak for additional discounts (3-year vs 1-year)
- Whether the 99.95% SLA from CloudPeak is sufficient or if we need to push for 99.99%
- Timeline: can we complete all migrations before the VaporLogic contract expires on January 31, 2025? This seems tight.

DECISION NEEDED
Approve consolidation plan and migration budget of $500,000, with target completion by June 30, 2025.

MARKET EXPANSION ANALYSIS - SOUTHEAST ASIA
Prepared by: Strategy Team
Date: October 22, 2024

EXECUTIVE CONTEXT
Our product (B2B SaaS productivity platform) has achieved $28M ARR in North America and Western Europe. Board has asked us to evaluate Southeast Asian expansion. Below is our analysis of three target markets.

MARKET 1: VIETNAM
- Total addressable market (TAM): $340M (estimated 2025)
- Current competitors: 3 local, 1 regional (no dominant player)
- Projected Year 1 revenue: $1.8M
- Projected Year 3 revenue: $7.2M
- Setup costs: $420,000 (legal entity, office, initial team of 6)
- Ongoing monthly costs: $95,000 (team, marketing, infrastructure)
- Time to first revenue: 5 months
- Key advantages: growing tech sector, English proficiency in target segment, favorable tax incentives for foreign SaaS
- Key risks: regulatory changes around data residency (new law expected mid-2025, details unclear), currency fluctuation (VND down 3.2% vs USD this year)

MARKET 2: THAILAND
- TAM: $290M (estimated 2025)
- Current competitors: 2 local, 2 regional (one strong player with 35% share)
- Projected Year 1 revenue: $1.2M
- Projected Year 3 revenue: $5.1M
- Setup costs: $380,000 (legal entity, office, initial team of 5)
- Ongoing monthly costs: $82,000
- Time to first revenue: 4 months
- Key advantages: established B2B SaaS market, faster company registration (2 weeks vs 8 weeks in Vietnam)
- Key risks: dominant competitor (ThaiTech Solutions) has deep local relationships, price sensitivity (average deal size 40% smaller than Vietnam), political instability (2 elections expected in 2025)

MARKET 3: INDONESIA
- TAM: $520M (estimated 2025, largest in SEA)
- Current competitors: 4 local, 3 regional (fragmented market, highest share is 18%)
- Projected Year 1 revenue: $2.1M
- Projected Year 3 revenue: $9.8M
- Setup costs: $610,000 (legal entity more complex, larger initial team of 8 needed for local support)
- Ongoing monthly costs: $130,000
- Time to first revenue: 7 months
- Key advantages: largest market, no single dominant competitor, government pushing digital transformation
- Key risks: complex regulatory environment (need local partner for first 2 years), infrastructure reliability outside Jakarta, Bahasa Indonesia localization required (estimated $45,000 and 10 weeks)

COMPARATIVE SUMMARY
- By TAM: Indonesia > Vietnam > Thailand
- By Year 3 revenue: Indonesia > Vietnam > Thailand
- By setup cost: Indonesia > Vietnam > Thailand
- By time to revenue: Thailand < Vietnam < Indonesia
- By competitive intensity: Thailand > Indonesia > Vietnam

RESOURCE CONSTRAINTS
We can only execute one market entry at a time with current team. Sequential entry would mean:
- If Vietnam first: Thailand in Q3 2025, Indonesia in Q1 2026
- If Thailand first: Vietnam in Q2 2025, Indonesia in Q1 2026
- If Indonesia first: Vietnam in Q3 2025, Thailand in Q1 2026

ADDITIONAL CONSIDERATIONS
- Our existing customer base includes 3 multinational clients with Southeast Asian operations who have asked about local support
- Hiring: Vietnam has strongest talent pipeline for our tech stack, Indonesia is challenging for senior hires
- Payment infrastructure: Thailand and Vietnam have mature digital payment, Indonesia still developing

DECISION NEEDED
Which market to enter first, with target launch date of March 1, 2025.
